Okay, so I need to figure out who died first between Madame Pasca and James A. Donohoe. From the conversation, I see that the WebSurfer was searching for information about both individuals. 

First, the WebSurfer found that Madame Pasca died on May 25, 1914. That seems pretty solid because the sources like Wikipedia and Geneastar both confirm that date. But then, when looking into James A. Donohoe, the WebSurfer came across multiple obituaries, but there was confusion between James A. Donohoe Jr. and James A. Donohoe III. 

The user initially thought that the death date for James A. Donohoe was November 4, 2013, but then the WebSurfer found that he actually died on August 23, 2018. That’s a big mix-up. The mistake was in not properly disambiguating between the Jr. and III versions, leading to incorrect conclusions about the death date and thus who died first.

So, the mistake was made by the WebSurfer when they didn't correctly identify which James A. Donohoe it was referring to, leading to the wrong death date being reported.
